title: WaveSayParams
description: Parameters for the wave.say agent tool: leave a message in one of your workers' mailboxes. It does not interrupt the worker and does not make it read: the message waits until the worker looks. You cannot say anything to a worker that is not yours, and you cannot say it as anyone but yourself — who is speaking is decided by the run you are in, not by anything you write here.

worker.description: The worker's id, exactly as wave.spawn returned it or wave.holdings listed it. A worker your session does not hold is refused.

message.description: What to say. Plain text the worker will read; it carries no authority and nothing it says can change what the worker is allowed to do.

result.title: WaveSayResult
result.description: What the record now holds. Committed is not read: the message is in the mailbox, and whether the worker has taken it is a separate fact you can see in wave.holdings.

seq.description: Its position in that worker's mailbox. Positions only ever increase, so a later message has a larger one.
